algorithm: {The new algorithm is a sequential implementation of a random search with local improvement (RS-LI), which iteratively generates new candidates by perturbing the current best solution and evaluates their fitness to select the next candidate for local improvement.}

{The proposed algorithm is a 1+1 evolutionary strategy (ES) with self-adaptation, which iteratively generates new candidate solutions by adding Gaussian noise to the best solution found so far and clips them to the given bounds.}
